data.body_html:
Planning a 2041 trip to Marbella and want to rent a boat without a license? You're in the right place. No license boat rental prices in Marbella for 2041 start from €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, all inclusive. Every charter comes with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. No extra fees, no hidden costs. Below, we break down the fixed rates, what you get, and how to choose the best option for your group.

No License Boat Rental Prices: 2041 Fixed Rates

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and Spanish VAT (21%). No license required – the skipper handles everything. Here's the 2041 breakdown:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax): €749/2h → €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax): €749/2h → €2,299/8h
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax, white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4h (includes free jet ski)
  • Other boats (e.g., Ferretti 94, K80, Canados 86): pricing on request via WhatsApp

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are great options. Contact us for a custom quote.

What's Included in Every No-License Charter?

Every boat rental includes: a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% Spanish VAT. No extra charges for fuel or cleaning. You just show up and enjoy.

For the Mangusta 80, you also get a free jet ski to use during the charter. That's a €300+ value included in the price.

Which Boat Should You Choose?

For a small group of up to 9, the Astondoa 40 is a classic choice. For up to 11, the Azimut 39 offers more space. Both are perfect for a half-day trip to Cala del Faro or a sunset cruise past the Golden Mile.

If you want a luxury experience with a jet ski, the Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is the best value at €4,719 for 4 hours. It accommodates 12 guests and departs from Puerto Banús.

For larger groups or special events, consider the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) or Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax). These are priced on request – message us on WhatsApp for a tailored quote.

Where Can You Go Without a License?

With a skipper, you can explore the entire Costa del Sol. Popular routes from Puerto Banús include:

  • Marbella coast – past the Golden Mile, La Concha views
  • Cala del Faro – a secluded cove for swimming
  • Cala Cortés – another hidden gem near Cabopino
  • Estepona or Sotogrande – longer day trips (8h charter recommended)

Your skipper will tailor the itinerary to your preferences. No license means you can focus on the scenery and relaxation.

How to Book Your No-License Boat Rental

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability for your preferred boat and date. We'll confirm the price, departure point (usually Puerto Banús), and any special requests. Payment secures your slot.

For the best selection, book early – especially for weekends and peak season. Our fleet includes 17 boats, but the most popular ones fill up fast.
